what.text: Asylum seekers from Honduras live in host countries including the United States, Mexico, Spain, Guatemala, and Italy.
At the end of 2025, there were 168464 Honduran asylum seekers recorded across all host countries combined.
This population reached 237701 asylum seekers at the end of 2024.

why.text: The sources do not report specific events or conflict causes for displacement from Honduras.
No opposition groups or active conflict periods are listed in the provided data.

when.text: The main displacement years recorded for Honduran asylum seekers span from 2019 to 2025.
At the end of 2000, host countries reported 1187 Honduran asylum seekers.
By the end of 2019, the year-end total of asylum seekers reached 122480 people.

how.text: The sources do not say which routes people take or how they live in host countries.
Asylum seekers from Honduras are counted as year-end totals on 31 December across all host countries combined.
Internal displacement caused by conflict is recorded as year-end totals of people living in displacement.
